name: Privilege API Explorer LAB
description: API collection for Privilege API Explorer LAB: the Privilege console API surfaced for browsing — the OpenAPI operation catalog (447 ops), one operation's detail, the saved connections, the audit log, and the diagram-studio read/write diagrams. In real mode the app proxies the console with key/secret headers server-side; the mock console is mock-mode only.

env.PRIVILEGE_EXPLORER_MODE: real or mock (the app's own mode key; the lab reads it from the shared env)

folders.name: Sanity
folders.description: Health, mode info, the saved connections and the audit log.

folders.name: Operation catalog
folders.description: The Privilege console OpenAPI catalog: browse all 447 operations, filter by tag in the UI, or fetch one operation's full detail.

folders.name: Diagrams
folders.description: The diagram-studio read and write diagrams (the write diagram is honest about the gates).

folders.name: Mock console (mock mode only)
folders.description: In mock mode the app serves an in-process mock console. In real mode this answers 409 mock_only — that refusal is the negative case here.
